title: At Risk revenue figure covers every at-risk customer
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as a user whose role has the Reports permission, for example an Administrator. To check a role: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > the Reports permission is switched on.
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. In the workplace selector pick a workplace where at least two customers are at risk on some window (on the QA environment, "QA Testing"; try 30 days).
custom_steps:
1. Open the dashboard and set the At Risk window to one where the headline is 2 or more.
  2. Read the supporting line's "$… (12mo)" amount and customer count.
  3. Click View details on At Risk Customers.
  4. Add up the Revenue (12 Mo) column over every row, on every page of the table.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The supporting line reads a dollar total, "(12mo) · ", the count and the word customers (e.g. "$1,250.00 (12mo) · 3 customers"), and the count equals the headline.
  • The $ amount equals the sum of Revenue (12 Mo) over all at-risk customers, every row on every page (e.g. $40.50 + $1,209.50 = $1,250.00). It is not the sum of the first page only.
  • If the table ever stops at 500 rows (it then says "Showing 500 of N at-risk customers"), the $ amount still covers all N customers. This cannot be reached by hand on normal data; write 'cap not reached' in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9577 (Story 5, Count Tiles, Sales by Customer and At Risk Customers); story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 5 (context note on the At Risk supporting line) and Story 6 (S6-R8). Also the Technical Implementation Plan (2026-09-16), FR-016 and the response contract, which add that the total is never a sum of the displayed rows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5 context note (At Risk revenue): “in the At Risk supporting line, "${revenue} (12mo)" is the customer's revenue over the last twelve months; for more than one customer it is the total across all at-risk customers.”
  • S5-R9: “The At Risk Customers tile shows a supporting line reading "${revenue} (12mo) · {count} customers" when more than one customer is at risk.”
  • S6-R8: “The At Risk Customers tile expands to the At Risk Customers table. The table is ordered by each customer's trailing-twelve-month revenue, highest first, with the customer name as the tiebreaker, so the largest amount at risk reads first. The table lists every at-risk customer. A safety cap of 500 rows applies: if a workplace ever exceeds it, the table shows the first 500 in that order and says so on screen, reading "Showing 500 of N at-risk customers", while the headline still counts every one. The table never truncates silently, because a table that stops short while the headline counts more is a defect: the two then disagree.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
